title: P0.1 process-aware energy + optimal aggregation vs self-consistency on purpose-built level-3 in-band corpus (v9)

field_provenance.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_ so the conductor reconciler classifies it as terminal without false-positive partial-token matches (CLAUDE.md Verdict Terminal-Prefix Discipline).
field_provenance.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates: no live model is loaded; duration floor is 1 s (not 60 s).  Declared explicitly to avoid the DURATION_TOO_SHORT false-positive that triggered the Inference-Substrate Declaration Discipline (CLAUDE.md 2026-05-22).
field_provenance.corpus_source: data/p01_difficulty_matched_generations.jsonl (purpose-built level-3) — the provenance; this is NOT the headroom-free cached GSM8K/MATH.
field_provenance.level3_n: In-band level-3 problems scored; >=40 required for headline-eligibility.
field_provenance.level3_sc: Majority-vote accuracy over the level-3 corpus — MUST land in [0.40, 0.70] (the headroom the cached corpora lacked).
field_provenance.self_consistency_in_headroom_band: boolean: level-3 SC in [0.40, 0.70] — the precondition that makes P0.1 testable.
field_provenance.best_step_aggregation: Which step->final aggregation (last/product/min/uncertainty) won on TRAIN (arXiv:2508.01773).  The process_energy module uses per-step mean + contradiction by default; this field documents the effective aggregation.
field_provenance.self_consistency_accuracy: Majority vote over k — the PRIMARY control (held-out).
field_provenance.self_certainty_bon_accuracy: Self-certainty Best-of-N (arXiv:2502.18581) — the cheap selector energy must beat.
field_provenance.process_energy_argmin_accuracy: FoVer step-level PROCESS energy argmin — per-step, not candidate-level.
field_provenance.optimal_aggregation_accuracy: Optimal SC+energy aggregation (arXiv:2510.13918) — THE headline condition.
field_provenance.flip_count_optimal_vs_sc: Problems where optimal-aggregation differs from SC — the tautology-clean primary signal (0 -> they agree, no separate bit-identical field).
field_provenance.flips_correct_optimal: Flips that became CORRECT (the win mechanism).
field_provenance.net_correctness_gain_optimal: flips_correct - flips_incorrect for optimal aggregation — the honest net effect.
field_provenance.delta_optimal_vs_self_consistency: Optimal-aggregation minus SC at matched compute — THE headline delta.
field_provenance.delta_process_energy_vs_self_consistency: Process-energy argmin minus SC — does per-step verification route into selection?
field_provenance.paired_significance: McNemar exact p + paired bootstrap CI95 for the optimal/process/hybrid deltas.
field_provenance.compute_parity_note: Per-condition generation budget + reranker/aggregator params so energy does not win by spending more compute.
field_provenance.random_seed: Determinism is the precondition for reproducibility; CONTENT-DERIVED (not the experiment number, which would trigger the exp3502 tautology class).
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: Content hash of corpus + reranker config + split + seed — catches silent corpus or config drift between runs.
field_provenance.duration_s: Cached scoring + small-model training; substrate is verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates so 1 s floor applies, not 60 s (no live model inference).

train_test_split_note: problem-level 5-fold CV (seed=1815308654); each problem's up to 6 samples are entirely in train OR held-out, never split; feature standardisation AND the optimal-aggregator lambda are fit on the train fold only. All accuracies are on held-out problems.
compute_parity_note: All sampled-aggregation conditions consume the SAME k=6 cached generations; greedy AR is the 1-sample floor.  The energy adds only a 7-parameter logistic reranker (4 verifier signals + mean logprob + step count) plus a 1-parameter optimal aggregator (the mixing coefficient lambda, fit on train) — no extra samples — so energy cannot win by spending more compute.
methodology_note: PRIMARY signal is the flip-count over the LEVEL-3 IN-BAND CORPUS, not a pair of accuracies: optimal-aggregation flips 0 of 49 held-out problems vs the SC majority (flips_correct=0, flips_incorrect=0).  Level-3 corpus built by exp3506 to land at aggregate SC in [0.4, 0.7].  Schema adapted from gold_answer_norm/extracted_answer_norm/reasoning_steps to the format expected by the process-energy module.
surprising_result_acknowledgment: Process-energy / optimal-aggregation result at n_heldout=49 with 5-fold problem-level CV over the level-3 in-band corpus.  A positive G1 (significant beat with positive net flip gain) would require independent replication before any headline claim.
